Tesla Opens Sixth India Experience Centre in Chennai

Electric vehicle manufacturer Tesla has opened its sixth India Experience Centre in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. The company stated this expansion is part of its effort to build charging and service infrastructure across India, aiming to enhance its retail and after-sales network. One report indicated a target for pre-Diwali delivery for orders placed in September.
